definitions.gloss: individually; separately; one by one; case by case
definitions.explanation: Adverbial form of the na-adjective/noun {個別|こべつ} ('individual, separate'). Indicates that an action applies to each person or item one at a time rather than collectively. Common in business, educational, and administrative contexts for describing tailored handling of cases, requests, or instruction.

examples.japanese: {個別|こべつ}に⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{個別|こべつ}に⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Each issue needs to be judged on a case-by-case basis.

examples.japanese: ご⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{個別|こべつ}にお⟦{答|こた}え→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: As for your questions, I'll answer them individually after this meeting.

notes:
Formed from the na-adjective/noun ⟦{個別|こべつ}→個別：11566_kobetsu⟧ ('individual, separate') + the adverbial particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. Widely used in formal and business settings to stress that treatment or handling is tailored to each case rather than uniform.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {個別|こべつ}に⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to handle/respond individually
- {個別|こべつ}に⟦{相談|そうだん}する→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧: to consult one-on-one
- {個別|こべつ}に⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧: to judge case by case
- {個別|こべつ}に⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧: to explain to each person separately
- {個別|こべつ}に⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧: to contact individually
- {個別|こべつ}に⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to teach/coach one-on-one

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧: each, respectively — emphasizes the set as a whole with distinctions; more neutral in tone
- ⟦{別々|べつべつ}→別々：03972_betsubetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: separately — emphasizes not mixing together (e.g., payment, packaging)
- ⟦{一人一人|ひとりひとり}→一人一人：03711_hitorihitori⟧: one by one (for people) — stresses the human individual
- ⟦{一|ひと}つずつ→一つずつ：24348_hitotsuzutsu⟧: one at a time — emphasizes sequential handling of items
- {個別|こべつ}に⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: respond individually (each case addressed on its own terms)
- ⟦まとめて→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: handle together/in a batch (the opposite approach)
